Class Catalog

java.lang.Object
Catalog
public class Catalog extends Object
Represents the library's catalog — a collection of all items (books and music) with search functionality. The catalog supports three overloaded search methods: by keyword (case-insensitive title match), by Author (exact match, Books only), and by RecordingArtist (exact match, Music only, including band members).

      public List<Item> search(String keyword)
      Searches the catalog for items whose title contains the given keyword. The search is case-insensitive.
      Parameters:
      keyword - the substring to search for in item titles
      Returns:
      a list of all items whose title contains keyword (case-insensitive); empty list if none match

    • search

      public List<Item> search(Author author)
      Searches the catalog for Books that have an exact match for the given Author.
      Parameters:
      author - the author to search for
      Returns:
      a list of Books whose author equals author; empty list if none match

    • search

      public List<Item> search(RecordingArtist artist)
      Searches the catalog for Music items associated with the given RecordingArtist. The artist may be the sole creator of the Music or a member of the Music's Band.
      Parameters:
      artist - the recording artist to search for
      Returns:
      a list of Music items whose creator is artist directly, or whose Band contains artist as a member; empty list if none match
